# CoreGraphics

**Symbols:** 62.0% of Apple's iOS API (739 of 1191, exact) · **Rows:** 43: 36 ✅ 3 🟡 4 ❌ · **iOS:** 2.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Graphics & text](../COVERAGE.md#graphics) · **Apple:** [CoreGraphics](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coregraphics) · **Issues:** [`area:graphics`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Agraphics)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** isim's own C implementation (`isim/frameworks/CoreGraphics`) over the host's cairo. isim parses PDFs itself (`CGPDFParser.c`: the object model, cross-reference tables and streams, filters, the standard security handler) and renders their pages with poppler-glib.

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |

| Graphics state, CTM (translate/scale/rotate/concat), alpha, line width/cap/join/miter limit | ✅ | ≤17 | caps/joins/miter limit unverified |

| `CGMutablePath.addArc(tangent1End:tangent2End:radius:transform:)`, `CGPathAddArcToPoint` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: a line to the first tangent point and a circular arc built from Bézier quarters; tested (CGPathTest) |
| `CGPath.copy(strokingWithWidth:lineCap:lineJoin:miterLimit:transform:)`, `CGPathCreateCopyByStrokingPath` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: isim's own outliner (bands per segment, miter / round / bevel joins with the miter limit, butt / round / square caps, then a winding union), so the outline is one non-overlapping filled shape; curves are flattened first and the transform maps the outline; tested (CGPathTest, HelloQuartz) |
| `CGPath.copy(dashingWithPhase:lengths:transform:)`, `CGPathCreateCopyByDashingPath` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: dashes along the flattened path (lengths before the transform), closed subpaths include their closing segment; tested (CGPathTest, HelloQuartz) |
| `CGPath.copy(using:)`, `mutableCopy(using:)`, `CGPathCreateCopyByTransformingPath`, `CGPathCreateMutableCopyByTransformingPath` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted; tested (CGPathTest, HelloQuartz) |
| `CGPath.isRect(_:)`, `CGPathIsRect` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: an axis-aligned rectangle (from `CGPath(rect:)` or four lines and a close); tested (CGPathTest) |
| `CGPath.union`, `intersection`, `subtracting`, `symmetricDifference`, `normalized(using:)`, `lineIntersection`, `lineSubtracting`, `componentsSeparated(using:)`, `flattened(threshold:)`, `intersects(_:using:)` and their C functions | ✅ | 16 | adapted: isim's own polygon clipper over flattened outlines (edges split at crossings, kept by the winding or even-odd rule), so results are made of lines; tested (CGPathTest, HelloQuartz) |
| `CGColor` (RGB, gray, copy with alpha, components in their space, `converted(to:)`) | ✅ | ≤17 | gray colors keep 2 components; tested (HelloQuartz) |
| `CGColorSpace` (sRGB, Display P3, linear, gray, CMYK, pattern) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: named spaces preserve their name/model/base/extended-range properties; colors convert to sRGB for drawing (exact Display P3 matrix, linear transfer, gray and CMYK; out-of-gamut clamped, no wide-color output); tested (HelloQuartz) |
| `CGColorSpaceCreateWithICCData`, `CGColorSpaceCopyICCData` (`CGColorSpace(iccData:)`, `copyICCData()`) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: isim reads the profile itself (no lcms2): its header and tag table; RGB matrix / TRC profiles (`rXYZ` / `gXYZ` / `bXYZ`, `curv` gamma or table, `para` functions 0–4) and gray `kTRC` profiles convert exactly to sRGB (Bradford D50 → D65); CGImages in the space are converted pixel by pixel; tested (CGExtrasTest, profiles it builds). Missing: LUT-based profiles (`A2B0`) draw as their device space, rendering intents are ignored |
| `CGColorSpaceCreateLab`, `kCGColorSpaceGenericLab` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: Lab → XYZ at the white point → D65 (von Kries) → sRGB, a and b clamped to the range; 8-bit images map L to 0…100 and a / b over the range; tested (CGExtrasTest, HelloQuartz) |
| `CGColorSpaceCreateIndexed`, `CGColorSpaceGetColorTableCount`, `CGColorSpaceGetColorTable` (`colorTable`), `CGColorSpaceCopyBaseColorSpace` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: colors and 8-bit images through the table and the base space (indices past the end take the last color); tested (CGExtrasTest, HelloQuartz) |
| `CGColorSpaceCreateExtended`, `CreateLinearized`, `CreateExtendedLinearized`, `CreateCopyWithStandardRange`; `kCGColorSpaceLinearDisplayP3`, `kCGColorSpaceExtendedDisplayP3`, `kCGColorSpaceExtendedRange` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: named spaces map to their named variants (sRGB, gray, Display P3); ICC and Lab spaces get extended-range copies and have no linear form; tested (CGExtrasTest, HelloQuartz) |
| `CGDataProviderCreateDirect`, `CGDataProviderCreateSequential` (`CGDataProviderDirectCallbacks`, `CGDataProviderSequentialCallbacks`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the bytes are read through the callbacks when the provider is created (byte pointer, bytes at positions, or sequentially after a rewind) and kept in memory; `releaseInfo` runs when the provider is freed; tested (CGExtrasTest) |
| `CGLayer` (`CGLayerCreateWithContext`, `size`, `context`, `CGContextDrawLayerInRect` / `AtPoint`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: a premultiplied RGBA bitmap at the context's device scale, drawn back as an image; tested (CGExtrasTest, HelloQuartz) |
| `CGContextDrawConicGradient` (`drawConicGradient(_:center:angle:)`) | ✅ | 17.0 | adapted: 720 wedges around the center, counterclockwise from the angle, filling the clip; tested (CGExtrasTest, HelloQuartz) |
| Pattern colors (`CGPattern`, `setFillPattern`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: colored and uncolored fill/stroke patterns; uncolored components use the pattern space's RGB/gray/CMYK base; cell drawn once at 2x and tiled relative to the current CTM, with phase and alpha; tested (HelloQuartz) |
| `CGImage` (from UIImage, crop, draw into context) | ✅ | ≤17 | decoded by the host |
| `CGImage` from raw bytes (`CGDataProvider`, `CGImageCreate`, `CGImageMaskCreate`, `masking`, `dataProvider`) | ✅ | ≤17 | 8 bits per component (RGB(A/X) in any order, gray, gray+alpha, alpha only, masks, decode arrays); 16-bit/float layouts are refused with a log; decoded images report premultiplied RGBA bytes; tested (HelloQuartz) |
| `CGBitmapContext` (`CGContext(data:...)`, pixel read/write, `makeImage`) | ✅ | ≤17 | draws into app memory (zero-copy for BGRA/A8, converted in/out for RGBA and gray), y-up like iOS; `UIGraphicsPushContext` makes UIKit draw into it; drawable from any thread (each thread has its own drawing target, as on iOS); tested (HelloQuartz, including drawing on a background thread while frames render) |
| `CGGradient`, `CGShading` (`CGFunction`) | ✅ | ≤17 | linear/radial with before/after extension; shadings sampled at 64 steps; tested (HelloQuartz). One-sided radial extension approximated |
| Line dashes (`setLineDash`) | ✅ | ≤17 | tested (HelloDrawing) |
| Shadows (`setShadow`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: operations draw as a group; alpha is blurred with a 3-pass box blur and offset in base space. Vector/PDF groups rasterize only the shadow mask, keeping the source operation vector; tested on bitmap/UIKit and PDF contexts (HelloQuartz) |
| Blend modes, transparency layers | ✅ | ≤17 | blend modes map to cairo operators (`plusDarker` approximated); layers composite with the outer alpha/shadow; multiply and layer tested (HelloQuartz) |
| Clip to mask (`clip(to:mask:)`) | ✅ | ≤17 | alpha of masks with alpha, luminance of opaque masks; tested (HelloQuartz) |
| Text drawing in CG (Core Text lines/frames, text matrix/position) | ✅ | ≤17 | glyphs drawn y-up through the text matrix (upside down in UIKit's flipped space, as on iOS); `CGContextShowTextAtPoint` (deprecated) unverified; text drawing modes other than fill/invisible draw as fill |
| `CGContext` queries (`ctm`, `boundingBoxOfClipPath`, `path`, `isPathEmpty`, conversions) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted through cairo; `replacePathWithStrokedPath` makes a flattened outline (exact segment width/caps, conservative round approximation for bevel/miter joins); tested (HelloQuartz) |
| PDF contexts (`CGContext(consumer:mediaBox:)`, `beginPDFPage`, `closePDF`) | ✅ | ≤17 | cairo PDF surface, y-up pages; tested (HelloQuartz) |
| `CGPDFDocument` / `CGPDFPage` (read, `drawPDFPage`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: isim's parser reads the objects (classic and cross-reference-stream files, object streams, incremental updates, a damaged xref rebuilt by scanning) and poppler-glib renders. Like Apple's, `drawPDFPage` draws the page without its
annotations (PDFKit draws them; poppler's print path still draws form fields). Version, catalog, info, file identifier, page dictionaries, the five boxes with inheritance and defaults, rotation, `getDrawingTransform`, outline (`CGPDFDocumentGetOutline`: titles, page destinations, `DestinationRect`, named destinations); tested (CGPDFTest, HelloQuartz) |
| Encrypted PDFs (`isEncrypted`, `isUnlocked`, `unlockWithPassword`, `allowsPrinting`, `allowsCopying`, `accessPermissions`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the standard security handler, RC4 40–128 bit (R2–R3), AES-128 (R4, crypt filters) and AES-256 (R5/R6), user and owner passwords; an empty user password unlocks by itself; the owner password allows everything; poppler renders with the password that unlocked it; tested (CGPDFTest) |
| `CGPDFObject`, `CGPDFDictionary`, `CGPDFArray`, `CGPDFString`, `CGPDFStream` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: values resolved through references; `ApplyFunction` / `ApplyBlock`; text strings in PDFDocEncoding, UTF-16BE and UTF-8; `CopyDate` with time zones; `CGPDFStreamCopyData` decodes Flate, LZW, ASCIIHex, ASCII85 and RunLength (with PNG/TIFF predictors) and hands JPEG / JPEG 2000 back encoded with their format; tested (CGPDFTest) |
| `CGPDFScanner`, `CGPDFContentStream`, `CGPDFOperatorTable` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: content streams of a page (one or an array, inherited resources) or of a form stream with a parent; operators call their callbacks with the operands on the stack; inline images reach `BI` as a stream; `CGPDFScannerStop`; tested (CGPDFTest, HelloQuartz) |
| PDF context links, destinations, outline, info (`setURL(_:for:)`, `addDestination(_:at:)`, `setDestination(_:for:)`, `CGPDFContextSetOutline`, `kCGPDFContextTitle`… keys) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted through cairo's PDF tags and outline; title, author, subject, keywords and creator written; tested (CGPDFTest, HelloQuartz). Missing: `addDocumentMetadata` is a stub (no XMP), and the encryption, PDF/A, PDF/X and output-intent keys are accepted but not written |
| `CGFont` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted subset: creation by name or an OpenType data provider; PostScript/full names and units/em (provider metadata parsed with HarfBuzz); `CGFontCopyTableTags` / `CGFontCopyTableForTag` (`tableTags`, `table(for:)`): a font by name through the host's HarfBuzz face, a font from data from its sfnt table directory (the first font of a collection); tested (HelloQuartz, CGExtrasTest). Missing: glyph advances / bounds and PostScript subsets |
